## Cybernetic Evolver v1.2.0 Changelog

- Expanded and clarified Skill-as-Module integration instructions for agent embedding.
- Added more detailed agent integration examples, including performance metric, state extractor, and action transformer usage.
- Improved documentation of the optimization workflow and interface injection patterns.
- No code changes; documentation/usage guidance only.
v1.1.0: 新增save/load/get_best_strategy/history/set_trigger_condition接口，支持持久化与元控制；修复_state_mean维度问题；元优化验证通过
Add MIT-0 license, clean publish via CLI

Initial release of Cybernetic Evolver.

- Implements an AI self-evolution framework inspired by Tsien's Engineering Cybernetics.
- Features closed-loop feedback, adaptive control, and self-organizing principles.
- Supports triggers in English and Chinese.
- Requires Python 3.8 or above.
